(2) STATIC records (_rs_*): plain buildings, resources, wrecks, facility walls/gatehouse/baffles, VTOL pad: one precomputed item per snapshot (key: snapshot, pf, allies, facility tick, wall gen, wall dirty); wreck seen-flag and soldier-on-wall checked per frame (full path then). PD71_RC_VERIFY=1: every refresh runs the full path, restores the motion / k8 / corpse state, runs the record path, and compares every pushed item (key, page, src, size, dst, dsz, mod), the sorted list, vis_units/vis_sp/vis_air/vis_bld (identity), all g5/g6/g61 counters, ww/bay/misc counters, badges; prints PD71_RC_DIFF (first 12) and PD71_RC_VERIFY progress every 120 refreshes.
